messages:
jamie_sales: Heads up — just got a SIG/CAIQ from NovaHealth (prospect). They want completed questionnaire + SOC2 evidence by EOD next Wed. Link: https://files.redwood/novahealth/sig-2026.docx

marco_csm: thanks. do we know deployment mode? hosted vs dedicated vs private?

jamie_sales: they said 'private deployment (VPC) with on-prem data residency' in the intake form. also requires HSM/KMS and support for their audit team.

sahil_sales: tagging security — is this something we can commit to in an onboarding timeline? cc @priya_security @emily_legal

security-bot: New security intake created: INT-2026-0837 (priority: high). Assigned to: unassigned. Link to ticket: https://issues.redwood/INT-2026-0837 :white_check_mark:

priya_security: I can take this. quick Qs: 1) what's the contract timeline? 2) will they ask for encryption key custody (customer-managed keys)? 3) estimated number of users and data classification?

jamie_sales: contract sig target = 2026-06-15 (probable). They indicated customer-managed keys for production. Data: PHI + PII, roughly 3000 users, several TB of data.

priya_security: thanks. rough ETA to complete SIG + evidence: 5 business days if we have their ATO scope docs and the specific control evidence requests. If they want in 2 business days we can provide a partial answer set (controls matrix + high-level evidence) and follow up with artifacts.

emily_legal: we should confirm data processing addendum and any subprocessor list before handing over keys. Jamie — can you confirm which legal template they're expecting?

jamie_sales: they're asking for our standard enterprise DPA + their security addendum. I'll loop legal and attach their addendum.

priya_security: action plan:
- Step 1: Sales to upload client's addendum + any existing ATO/scope docs (jamie)
- Step 2: Security to fill SIG baseline + map to evidence (Priya)
- Step 3: Engineering ops to prepare screenshots/log pulls for KMS/HSM config (need assignee)
- Step 4: Legal to review/confirm DPA and key custody language (Emily)

jamie_sales: uploaded addendum and intake form to the ticket. link: https://files.redwood/novahealth/addendum.pdf

marco_csm: can engineering ops estimate time for KMS evidence? @sahil_sales — who should we ping on ops?

sahil_sales: pinging @ryan_ops in #eng-infra. Ryan — can you confirm whether we can produce KMS/HSM config screenshots and access logs for private deployments?

priya_security: FYI — likely evidence set we'll provide: CAIQ sections (A.1-A.5), encryption key diagrams, KMS rotation policy, SOC2 extracts (if available), network segmentation diagrams. If we don't have SOC2 yet, we'll provide compensating controls.

emily_legal: noted. if customer requests 3rd-party audit artifacts, we should route via sales + legal — do not send raw logs to customer. Provide vetted extracts only.

security-bot: INT-2026-0837 updated: assignee -> priya_security; labels: sig, onprem, high-priority

priya_security: putting a checklist in the ticket now. Estimated complete for full evidence: 2026-05-29. Will post progress updates in this thread.

jamie_sales: great — please call out any blockers early. i'll tell the customer we can do a partial deliverable by 2026-05-25 and full set by 5/29.

marco_csm: small ask — can we include a short two-page security summary PDF they can share internally? that's what procurement typically wants first.

priya_security: yes. I'll create an executive security summary + a controls mapping doc.

sahil_sales: thanks team. keeping this thread pinned on the deal channel. :thumbsup:

jamie_sales: one more: they asked whether we support dedicated logging exports to their Splunk — is that in scope for private?

priya_security: yes for private deployments we support push/export patterns. I'll add sample dataflow and retention table to the evidence package.

emily_legal: reminder — before sharing any architecture diagrams with environment labels, strip internal hostnames and IPs.

priya_security: will do. next update by EOD tomorrow.

jamie_sales: thanks everyone. i'll update the customer timeline and close out follow-ups in CRM. :rocket:
